description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDao class, which provides data access methods for managing performance review entities, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting reviews, as well as managing reviewers, ratings, and related entities within the orangehrmPerformancePlugin module.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing performance reviews, including CRUD operations, reviewer management, and rating updates, encapsulating data interactions with the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees supervised by a specified employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee-supervisor relationships matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: createReview
methods.description: Creates and persists a new performance review, associating it with reviewer entities.

methods.name: saveReviewer
methods.description: Internal method to create and save a reviewer entity linked to a performance review, and optionally set as a reviewer by employee number.

methods.name: saveReviewerRating
methods.description: Stores reviewer ratings for KPIs associated with a performance review.

methods.name: getEditableReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review that is inactive and editable by ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewById
methods.description: Retrieves a performance review by its ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Fetches a list of performance reviews based on search filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of performance reviews matching search filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder for fetching performance reviews based on various search filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Returns the status string of a self-review for a performance review.

methods.name: updateReview
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review and its reviewers within a transaction.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviewReviewers
methods.description: Deletes all reviewer records associated with a performance review.

methods.name: getSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor relationships for subordinate and supervisor employee IDs.

methods.name: getReviewKPI
methods.description: Fetches KPIs associated with the specified performance review.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer record corresponding to the employee's self-review.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviews
methods.description: Deletes multiple performance reviews by their IDs.

methods.name: getReviewById
methods.description: Fetches performance review by ID, can return null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceReviewIds
methods.description: Finds existing performance review IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getKpisForReview
methods.description: Retrieves KPIs for a specific review based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewCount
methods.description: Returns count of KPIs matching review filter criteria.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds the query for fetching KPIs related to a review with filters.

methods.name: savePerformanceReview
methods.description: Persists a performance review entity to the database.

methods.name: setReviewerStatusToCompleted
methods.description: Updates reviewer status to 'completed' for a given review ID.

methods.name: getReviewIdsForSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves review IDs associated with a supervisor reviewer, filtering out inactive reviews and purged records.

methods.name: getPurgeEmployeeReviewIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of performance reviews associated with employees who have been purged.

methods.name: getReviewIdList
methods.description: Returns IDs of all active performance reviews.

methods.name: getSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves self-review IDs for an employee filtered by allowed statuses.

methods.name: getReviewerRating
methods.description: Fetches reviewer ratings for a supervisor evaluation based on filter parameters and group.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts reviewer ratings for a supervisor evaluation and group.

methods.name: getEvaluationRatingQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds query for reviewer ratings with filters.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForReviewId
methods.description: Gets KPI IDs associated with a specific review.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves KPI IDs linked to a specific job title.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewerRatings
methods.description: Bulk saves or updates reviewer ratings efficiently.

methods.name: getReviewerRecord
methods.description: Fetches a reviewer entity for a specific review and group.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of reviewers in a specific review and group.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates reviewer comments for a specific review and group.
